summary: Iteration 13 - Frontend E2E of Organizations/Users/Invites/Leads/Audit/Org-Switcher for Super Admin. 17/17 Playwright checks PASS. Verified: Super Admin login, operational sidebar + 'Amministrazione piattaforma' group (Dashboard piattaforma, Lead, Supporto, Audit Log), 'Org attiva' switcher visible; /piattaforma loads with new-org-btn; created Interna org 'QA Interna Test <ts>' via new-org-dialog (nome/type=interna/status=active), auto-navigated to /piattaforma/org/<id>; all 4 tabs render (dati/utenti/eventi/audit); Dati save works; Utenti tab: added organizer.test@crmevent.it as member, changed role (user↔admin_org), toggled active/disable, then removed; Invite: sent qa.invitato@example.com (email_sent=false expected for @example.com), invite row appears in invites-table, resend and revoke both work; /invito?token=INVALID renders invite-error 'Invito non valido'; /audit page renders audit-log-page with audit-table, all 4 filter testids present, filtering by the new org_id returns 10 audit rows covering org_created/member_added/role_change/toggle/remove/invite lifecycle; /lead page loads, 1 lead present, opening lead-row-<id> shows lead-detail with lead-no-account state, stato change (lead-stato) persists; Org switcher: on /eventi the org-switcher-select + super-acting-banner render, switching to the new org updates banner to 'Stai operando come Super Admin in: QA Interna Test <ts>'.
critical_code_review_comments: Platform.jsx createOrg uses window.location.href for hard navigation (line 60) — intentional so Layout re-fetches /my/organizations and the new org shows in org-switcher. Works, but a soft nav + explicit refresh of orgs in AuthContext would be smoother.
OrgDetail.jsx removeMember uses window.confirm — fine for now but consider replacing with the shadcn AlertDialog for consistency.
Invite.jsx: the useRef 'done' guard prevents re-running effect on StrictMode double invoke — good. Google redirect uses hardcoded auth.emergentagent.com URL; acceptable for Emergent auth.
server.py file size flagged in previous iterations still applies (module split candidate).
